a food supplier, not a restaurant operator or franchisor."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Franchises quick-service restaurants under its brand and runs company restaurants, matching Wendy's franchise model and food-service customers."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures and distributes packaged beverages to retailers, a beverage production business with no restaurant operations."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Sells merchandise to consumers through television and online shopping, a retail business unrelated to restaurants."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Makes household disposables such as foil and bags sold through grocery and mass retailers, not restaurant operations."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Processes and packs canned and frozen vegetables for grocery and food service buyers, a packaged food manufacturer."},{"label":"C15","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures plant-based beverages and fruit ingredients for retailers and brands, a food manufacturing business."},{"label":"C16","good":false,"reason":"Operates upscale full-service steakhouse and Japanese dining restaurants, unlike Wendy's quick-service hamburger model."},{"label":"C17","good":false,"reason":"Markets protein snacks and shakes sold through grocery and online retail, a packaged food brand without restaurant operations."},{"label":"C18","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures and sells candy to retailers and distributors, a confectionery business rather than a restaurant."},{"label":"C19","good":false,"reason":"Designs and sells premium apparel and accessories through stores and wholesale, a fashion business unrelated to restaurants."}]}
